description: Search or page through the items of the latest complete run. Returns delivered items (what channels receive) by default, with base (pre-rules) available via view. query matches id, title, brand, and product type, case-insensitive.

offset.description: Scan offset into the run for paging (default 0).

query.description: Substring match on id, title, brand, or product type. Omit to page through everything.

view.description: delivered = after rules (default); base = as ingested.

name: search_items
title: Search items
